top_deficiency_types.title: Install emergency lighting that can last at least 1 1/2 hours.

Ensure heating and ventilation systems that have been properly installed according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Install corridor and hallway doors that block smoke.
Protect each resident from the wrongful use of the resident's belongings or money.

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide pharmaceutical services to meet the needs of each resident and employ or obtain the services of a licensed pharmacist.

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide safe, appropriate dialysis care/services for a resident who requires such services.
